fusions.name: Cold-Shod Blow
fusions.desc: A shod kick that deals 34 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Trap-Jaw Line
fusions.desc: Sets a line of iron jaws 4 tiles long for 5 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hexproof Hide
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hardened by Near Misses
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack, 42% at full. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
